summary: Validated new Edit/Delete workout feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (PATCH recalc points Yoga 20/60 -> Running 45/320 = 92 pts, PATCH non-owner 403, PATCH bad id 404, PATCH duration<=0 400, DELETE owner + second delete 404, DELETE non-owner 403). Frontend: Playwright flow as fresh user 'Eddie' - logs Yoga 20/60 (36 pts), only own item shows edit-btn-{id}/delete-btn-{id} (verified only 1 pair among 9 feed items), Edit prefills correctly, header shows 'Editing / Fix Workout', projected updates to 92, Save shows 'Workout updated' toast with 92, feed & stat card reflect 92, Delete confirm dialog opens, 'Keep it' preserves item, 'Delete' removes item and stat drops to 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PATCH/DELETE use user_id from request body/query for ownership check (no real auth). Acceptable for MVP but should move to session/JWT before prod.
TEST_* seed users from backend tests (TEST_Owner_ED, TEST_Other_ED) now appear on the leaderboard; consider a cleanup fixture to purge TEST_ prefixed users/workouts after runs.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_Owner_ED and TEST_Other_ED users plus a few workouts (not fully cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit/Delete feature verified. Test data leakage: TEST_Owner_ED user has ~200 pts on leaderboard from pytest runs. Consider cleanup if future leaderboard tests are sensitive.
